benchmarks.label: Q1 optimised at 10% scale (cutoff 2024-03-20). Subscription: time_bucket('1 month') on daily_revenue_by_tier (day < 2024-03-20) — reads only aggregate rows in window. Marketplace: raw LATERAL scoped to cutoff.
Q2 optimised at 10% scale (cutoff 2024-03-20). Identical to naive — 4-table JOIN, no TS benefit for point lookups.
Q3 optimised at 10% row-based scale (10% of session users). No date cutoff — sessions in 2025. Identical to naive.
Q4 optimised at 10% scale (cutoff 2024-03-20). Identical to naive — plain tables, no TS benefit.
Q5 optimised at 10% scale (cutoff 2024-03-20). Identical to naive — products is a plain table.
Q6 optimised at 10% scale (cutoff 2024-03-20). 1-month chunks: 30-day window touches 1-2 chunks. Compression segmentby=user_id: contiguous user segments.

Q7 optimised at 10% scale (cutoff 2024-03-20). time_bucket_gapfill on daily_revenue_by_tier scoped to cutoff. Subscription: reads only aggregate rows in window (~very few at 10%). Marketplace: raw LATERAL scoped to window.
